content: The exploitation of individuals through sexual abuse and coercion into dependency on illegal drugs and other harmful substances, as well as their involvement in legal conflicts, represents a significant societal issue. A young girl in Chad is seen smiling during a skit focused on HIV prevention at a youth center in Moundou. This center educates adolescents on methods to prevent HIV transmission and provides free HIV testing services. Additionally, the center offers a small library, a game area, a drama club, and other extracurricular activities to engage the youth. In Odessa, Ukraine, a 14-year-old boy named Artem is pictured sitting on a wall outside the shelter called Way Home, where he resides. This UNICEF-supported shelter provides essential services such as food, accommodation, literacy training, and outreach programs for HIV/AIDS awareness and prevention. These services are targeted at children who live or work on the streets, a population particularly vulnerable to HIV due to unsafe sexual practices and injecting drug use. In Gujarat, India, Youth Information Centers train engaged adolescents to disseminate critical information about HIV/AIDS and other health-related issues, empowering them to educate their peers and communities. In the village of Makuzese, Zimbabwe, Monica, who is HIV-positive, is photographed sitting on a bed at home with her 14-year-old granddaughter, Sympathy. This image highlights the intergenerational impact of HIV and the resilience of affected families.
